evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure is required to verify growth-stage atmosphere.
Exhaust oxygen has risen progressively to 21.9 ppm; this raises concern about atmosphere integrity but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 749.8 °C and argon flow 99.9 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm, but tube pressure remains unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: A valid tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; oxygen acceptance limits and an independent atmosphere/leak check would clarify the rising O2. No sample characterization is available.
